visualReview.scope: Exterior render integrity; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current portable views. Closed open bevel/seal seams and removed facade mullions from revolving entrance openings. Opt-in antialiasing reduces fine-joint artifacts; fitting sun shadows to the loaded bounds removes the default small-scene shadow error in the lobby. Separate notched office plans, northwest terrace, vertical plant louvres, glazed lobby and unobstructed door leaves render. Fine joints/louvres still alias at distant viewpoints and require future LOD treatment. Glass casts conventional opaque shadows; this is not an optical glass simulation.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current viewer frames, including full-resolution door and north-up placement images. Five canonical material graphs each load once; no embedded images. Unloading leaves zero live model geometries. A neighboring catalog entry is loaded inside the query radius but hidden in the isolated target fixture. The flat fixture cannot establish actual street elevation.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q1351208 match to OSM way 278033587, corroborated by NYC BIN 1088795. Ground envelope follows the map at anchor [-74.012017084,40.710325481], heading -0.513459789133. Office plans retain independent reconstructed proportions and provisional translation. Signed facade fit, site registration of drawing north and current pavement datum remain pending.

fidelityReview.notes: 297.7 m architectural height, 279.9 m highest occupied floor, 46 ft lobby, 5 ft glass module and owner 13 ft 5 in floor interval are represented. The architect unit height differs by one inch. Office plan dimensions, upper diagonal endpoints/translation, transfer heights, entrance allocation and roof plant are not fully measured. Municipal 2014 survey archive had no usable geometry at this site. Do not count this preview as completed.
